_doc: The only state the story may read or write. Every change goes through a named effect in a storylet and is logged with that storylet's id. Add a variable here before using it anywhere; tools/narr_check.py rejects unknown names.

integration.doc: How far the player has let Pell through its firewalls.

pell.trust.doc: Pell's trust in the captain (separate from integration).

trust.abara.doc: Per-officer trust. Bands: 0-19 hostile, 20-39 guarded, 40-59 working, 60-79 loyal, 80+ devoted.

patron.suspicion.doc: Only what the player has actually found; never a hidden score.

ames.doc: Host-ship boarding hand; fate set in the standoff (P3).

p3.round_shot.doc: Round in which the player shot Corvane; 0 if never.

murdered.doc: Player shot Corvane in P3 round 1, before any tension. Read by Act 1.2 lines, the patron, and the captains' bar.

ames.bond.doc: How well the player bonded with Ames in P1.

quiet_hour.doc: Corvane's nightly hour alone with Pell, decided at the first crew meeting (1.3).

p3.answered_mirror.doc: Player gave Corvane an honest answer to the R5 mirror question.

corvane.talked.doc: Persuaded route: the player heard Corvane out in her cabin (1.4A).

corvane.afraid.doc: Corvane learned the blessing was predated (1.4A).

corvane.lied_to.doc: Player told Corvane the blessing came after (1.4A).

promise.abara_message.doc: Player promised to pass Corvane's message to Abara.

patterns.knows.<fact>: bool. fact must exist in knowledge.csv. The player has learned it.
patterns.told.<fact>.<crew>: bool. fact must exist in knowledge.csv; crew is an officer id or pell. That person was told.
patterns.seen.<id>: bool. Any dotted id (storylet id, or <scene>.<beat> such as seen.p1.what_if_right, seen.abara.hook1). Set when that beat plays; powers once/cooldown and later callbacks.

_timeline: Corvane: 47. CSRA Tally enforcement for 11 years, then gleaner captain about 14 years (Abara from the start). Found the relay station 3 years ago; asked her last crew to help, they refused, she scuttled that ship (Dunne made the boats); took this ship after. Took the core and Pell came aboard 6 weeks ago. Standoff ends ~22:13 ship time; P4 ~23:15; 1.1 next morning (~10 hours aboard).
